THE IDEA 01 — 04

See the creative act
inside the theorem.

A theorem is a finished sentence. The interesting story is how someone found the right question, changed the picture, noticed what stayed fixed, and invented a way to say why.

01

Choose a representation

Draw the object, write an equation, or turn it into a symmetry.

02

Make a move

Vary a condition. Glue, reflect, permute, or count.

03

Find what survives

Follow an invariant through the change, then risk a conjecture.

04

Build the proof

Learn why the pattern holds, and where its assumptions matter.
